QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Analog Souls
QuestInfo.0: Surana has an important request. Go talk to her to see what it's about.
QuestInfo.1: Surana is just as interested in artificial life as Eremos, however she disagrees with some of the assumptions he has made about their research. She is particularly interested in mechanical life. Collect 500 mechanical organism parts to aid her investigation.
QuestInfo.2: Eremos discovered your task for Surana and was greatly displeased. It seems the differences in their scientific philosophies may be too great, but Surana is determined to make a new discovery.
